title: AI Observability | Zenity AI Security Platform
text:
See Every Agent, Know What it Touches

Live inventory of every AI agent across your environment with the context needed to understand ownership, permissions, integrations, and risk.

Get a demo
Recognized by
Agents Show Up Faster Than Anyone Can Approve Them

AI agents get created inside SaaS platforms, wired into custom frameworks, and spun up on individual laptops, often without security ever finding out. Most inventory tools were built to catalog servers and SaaS licenses, not agents; they don't reliably show which agents exist, who owns them, or what data they've touched.

AI Observability is Zenity's discovery and visibility layer for AI agents. It builds a live inventory of every agent across an organization's environment and tracks the data those agents access, giving security teams a starting point before evaluating configuration or runtime behavior.

One Inventory for Every Agent

Security teams get a straight answer to what usually takes tickets and guesswork, like what agents exist and what they’ve touched across the organization.

Complete Agent Discovery

Each agent comes with its configuration, permissions, and tool access attached, so a newly discovered agent is immediately investigatable, not just a line item.

Step level behavioral monitoring

Contextual analysis of agent execution paths, tool invocations, memory updates, decision flows, RAG queries, file access, and user attachments.

Exposure measured by what's actually touched

Data and tools agents access get tracked for how often and by whom, so overshared or sensitive files surface based on real usage, not a hunch.

From Discovery to Data
Visibility
Inventory
Runtime
Every agent in one inventory

AI Observability scans an organization's environment and catalogs every agent whether it's embedded in a SaaS platform, custom-built, or running on someone's laptop.

Key Features:

Continuous discovery across SaaS, custom, and endpoint deployments
Counts and trends for agents, threads, and MCPs over time
Flags for agents operating outside sanctioned deployment channels
Wherever an Agent Runs

AI Observability applies the same discovery and activity tracking no matter where an agent lives.

Critical Protection Scenarios:

Agentic SaaS

AI Observability builds a full inventory and activity record for agents inside platforms like Microsoft Copilot Studio, ChatGPT Enterprise, and Salesforce Agentforce.

Cloud & homegrown agents

The same discovery and activity tracking extends to homegrown agents built on frameworks like Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.

Coding and personal agents

AI Observability extends visibility to coding assistants and local MCPs running outside centrally managed platforms.

Overshared data

Data Lens surfaces sensitive files and pages that are both frequently accessed and broadly exposed across agents.
